create_efficientnet_config: create an EfficientNetConfig instance with default efficientnet-b7 style settings
create_efficientnet_config_custom: create an EfficientNetConfig instance with custom width and depth coefficients

review_efficientnet_config: review the EfficientNetConfig class and its hyperparameters for network scaling
